prompt:
A 3-minute instrumental track. Instrumental only, no vocals, no lyrics.
Genre: modern Chinese guofeng trap / Asian-fusion trap, cinematic and steady, made as background for knowledge and science videos.
Tempo: exactly 112 BPM, 4/4, the tempo never changes. Key: F minor.
Harmony: one four-bar loop repeated through the whole song: Fm | Fm | Db | Eb (one chord per bar). In the peak section the loop becomes Fm | Gb | Db | Eb.
Instruments: guzheng carries the main melody (bright plucked phrases with slides and tremolo), a dizi bamboo flute answers it and doubles the melody in the bigger sections, warm synth pad underneath, deep 808 sub bass on the chord roots, trap drum kit: punchy kick on beat 1 and the "and" of beat 2, crisp snare/clap on beats 2 and 4, constant 16th-note hi-hats with triplet hi-hat rolls at the end of every 4 bars, soft reverse-cymbal risers into each new section. Original melody, short 2-bar phrases that repeat and are easy to remember.
The groove stays steady and driving for the whole song; changes come from adding and removing layers, not from changing tempo.

[0:00 - 0:17] Intro (8 bars): guzheng melody over the pad with soft filtered drums and sub; in bars 6-8 the drums drop out, only guzheng and pad, a riser builds.
[0:17 - 1:24] Main section (32 bars): full beat drops in on the downbeat with 808, hats and clap; guzheng melody, dizi answers; every 8 bars a small new layer.
[1:24 - 1:44] Breather (8 bars): melody instruments become softer and darker, drums keep a lighter groove, the last bar is a one-bar stop with a riser.
[1:44 - 2:18] Main section again (16 bars): full beat returns, guzheng and dizi together, brighter.
[2:18 - 2:48] Peak (14 bars): the biggest and fullest part: heavier 808, wider pads, dizi and guzheng in unison an octave apart, louder drums, same tempo.
[2:48 - 3:02] Outro (6 bars): drums stop, guzheng plays the motif one last time over the pad, ending on F minor.

description.en: Jackie's pick: the Chinese-colour alternative to Pulse · Strings (take C1, sped up 1.5% to 111.6 BPM). Steady trap groove for explainers: kick and clap backbeat, 16th hi-hats with rolls, 808 sub, a four-bar minor loop, section changes every 8-16 bars.
description.zh: Jackie 精选：「脉搏 · 弦」的国风备选（C1 版，提速 1.5% 到 111.6 BPM）。为知识科普视频做的稳定 Trap 律动：底鼓加二四拍拍手、16 分音符踩镲和滚奏、808 低音、四小节小调循环，每 8 到 16 小节换一层。

metadataBasis: description, style, tempo, moods and energy are prompt intent; tempo of edited takes measured by beat-grid fit; duration is measured; no automated audio review
